blind_target.evidence_quote: Although previous studies using this method support the persistence of the effect, supporting activation-based theories (e.g., Rantzen & Markham, 1992), these findings are based on a limited number of older studies. Therefore, in the current project, we replicated the reversed order procedure to distinguish between competing memory-based explanations of the misinformation effect.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Importantly, we found no misinformation effect in the reversed order procedure, contrasting previous studies using the methodology (e.g., Lindsay & Johnson, 1989; Rantzen & Markham, 1992).

blind_target.evidence_quote: The results presented in this study evaluated these optimized forms in data from an additional independent randomized pediatric schizophrenia trial (Savitz et al., 2015 ). blind_target.evidence_quote: This study presents a systematic replication of Kim, Shaver, and Funk's (2022) novel framework for measuring the dynamics of industry clusters.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our reproductions and exact replications validate the original findings reported by Kim et al. (2022) for the semiconductor industry, confirming the reliability of the measurement framework.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit validation verdict covers the original semiconductor findings. The abstract also reports reproductions but does not establish numerical agreement or robustness on the original data; supplemental axes are unresolved.
